newsitem.title: UK: Britain welcomes better Bahrain-Qatar relations.
newsitem.headline: Britain welcomes better Bahrain-Qatar relations.

text.p: Britain on Saturday welcomed moves by Bahrain and Qatar to improve their relations, saying it would bolster cooperation and security in the Gulf region.
"We warmly welcome the announcement that representatives of Bahrain and Qatar have met this week and will normalise and improve relations between them," a Foreign Office statement said.
The statement followed a meeting in London on Friday between Bahrain's crown prince and Qatar's foreign minister which helped to ease strains after a failed coup attempt in Qatar last year.

Qatar's foreign minister had accused Bahrain's crown prince of participating in the coup bid. The two nations are also locked in a territorial dispute over the small but potentially rich Gulf islands controlled by Bahrain since the 1930s.
The Foreign Office said that Friday's meeting would pave the way for Bahrain to attend the February 17 meeting between European Union foreign ministers and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC).
"This announcement...will greatly strengthen the GCC and its ability to cooperate in the interest of the security of the region," the statement said.
